questions.prompt: Magnetic heading is 300°. A fixed-card ADF indicates relative bearing 270° clockwise from the nose. Find the magnetic bearing TO the station (000°–359°).

questions.prompt: Steady one-dimensional flow passes a nozzle throat at 6 kg/s. LOCAL throat density is 1.2 kg/m³ and LOCAL velocity 250 m/s. Find throat area in m².
